summary.en: Development is dominated by complex generics, drug-device products and biosimilars rather than a conventional novel-drug pipeline. The tirzepatide ANDAs and biosimilar expansion illustrate that strategy.
summary.zh: 开发以复杂仿制药、药械组合产品和生物类似药为主,而非传统的创新药管线。tirzepatide ANDA 和生物类似药扩张体现了这一策略。

ind.en: Diabetes and weight management; references Mounjaro and Zepbound
ind.zh: 糖尿病和体重管理;涉及Mounjaro和Zepbound

next.en: FDA decision on US biosimilar application
next.zh: FDA对美国生物类似药申请的决定

next.en: Estimated approval and launch of epinephrine prefilled syringe
next.zh: 肾上腺素预充式注射器的预计获批和上市

watch.en: Kashiv acquisition expanded biosimilar R&D and manufacturing capabilities.
watch.zh: 收购 Kashiv 扩大了生物类似药研发和生产能力。

watch.en: FDA accepted two generic tirzepatide ANDAs; no approval date stated.
watch.zh: FDA 已受理两项 tirzepatide 仿制药 ANDA;未说明获批日期。

watch.en: 2026 operating cash-flow guidance was reduced to $325–375 million as inventory increased.
watch.zh: 由于库存增加,2026 年经营现金流指引下调至 $325–375 million。

sources: Adcomfo European approval and pending US BLA, November 17, 2026
gaps: No published clinical-phase counts located; generic ANDA and program totals are not converted into clinical phases.

The pipeline URL exposes inconsistent snapshots: opened text is dated April 2026, while the current search-indexed company text is dated November 2026 and moves epinephrine PFS estimated approval/launch to Q2 2027. The newer stated date is used; it does not establish filing status.

Omalizumab was approved in Europe on November 17, 2026 and in the UK in March; only the explicitly pending US BLA is represented as reg. The dated November release gives no US FDA action date, so the older estimated Q4 approval is removed.
Epinephrine PFS filing status, target and origin remain unverified and null. No dated decision was verified for the tirzepatide ANDAs.
Approved launch opportunities, including romidepsin and denosumab, remain excluded.
The supplied checker rejects null phase/origin values although the research brief permits them; unsupported values are retained as null rather than invented to satisfy validation.
